sources.quote_excerpt: When you photograph tiny subjects, sharpness becomes everything.
In landscape photography, slight softness might not always be obvious, but in macro photography, every tiny detail matters.
If the lens isn't incredibly sharp, those details simply disappear.
The result is outstanding sharpness across the entire frame.
Even at wide apertures, the level of detail this lens captures is remarkable.
When you photograph a flower with this lens, it doesn't just look sharp.
In most cases, detail photographers rely heavily on tripods to keep their images sharp.
With the RF 100mm Macro, you can maintain sharpness even at slow shutter speeds, making it much easier to capture well-exposed images in natural light.
A 100mm macro lens sits in a perfect sweet spot.
A lens that is sharp, versatile, reliable, and capable of revealing the beauty of nature at an entirely new scale.
It's outstanding sharpness ensures every texture and pattern remains crystal clear.

The bottom line is this lens is very sharp, very dependable, very good value, and very fun.
